title: [Audit] Kibana session reconstruction
description: Replay a user's Kibana session end to end. Filter to one kibana.session.id to see exactly what that person did, in order. Kibana events only — sessions are a Kibana concept, and body.text renders each one as a sentence.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE attributes.kibana.session.id IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.kibana.session.id, attributes.event.action, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, attributes.kibana.space.id, client.ip, body.text | SORT @timestamp DESC
